description: This file defines the 'ConfiguratorViewFontManager' class, which handles the display and management of font files within the SuiteCRM configuration module. It includes methods for rendering a font management interface, generating JavaScript data tables, and formatting font attributes.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewFontManager
classes.description: A view class responsible for managing and displaying the font management interface in the SuiteCRM configuration module.

methods.name: FontManager
methods.description: Constructor method intended to initialize the class, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the font management page, including fetching font files, setting up view variables, and invoking the template display.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code used in the view (currently empty).

methods.name: getYuiColumnDefs
methods.description: Generates the column definitions for the YUI DataTable displaying font information.

methods.name: getYuiDataSource
methods.description: Creates a JSON string representing the font list data source for the DataTable.

methods.name: getYuiResponseSchema
methods.description: Provides the response schema for the YUI DataTable.

methods.name: formatStyle
methods.description: Formats the font style attribute into a human-readable label with HTML styling.

methods.name: formatType
methods.description: Translates font type constants into localized string labels.

methods.name: isAllOOBFont
methods.description: Checks if all fonts in the list are core fonts embedded within the application.
